day.name: Hermes Agent
day.description: Hermes Agent is an open-source, self-improving AI agent by Nous Research that runs persistently with memory across sessions, and builds reusable skills from experience. It comes with 40+ built-in tools, including web search, browser automation, and vision, plus scheduled automations and subagents.

day.name: Kilo Code
day.description: Kilo Code is an open-source AI coding agent that works across VS Code, JetBrains, and CLI to help developers ship code faster with agentic workflows.

day.name: OpenClaw
day.description: OpenClaw is an open-source AI agent that connects to your messaging apps and takes real actions on your behalf, from running commands and browsing the web to managing files and sending emails.

day.name: Claude Code
day.description: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that reads your entire codebase, plans and executes changes across files, runs tests, and iterates on failures, all from natural language prompts.

day.name: pi
day.description: There are many coding agents, but this one is yours.

day.name: Lemonade
day.description: The AI tool for Roblox games.

day.name: Cline
day.description: Cline is an open-source AI coding agent that lives inside your IDE, autonomously exploring your codebase, editing files, running terminal commands, and using browser automation.

day.name: ISEKAI ZERO
day.description: AI adventures. Travel with your favorite characters

day.name: Pioneer (development)
day.description: Inference API that improves with your traffic

day.name: Janitor AI
day.description: Janitor AI is a chatbot platform where users create and chat with custom AI characters for interactive roleplay, storytelling, and immersive fiction.

day.name: Pieces.app: Ambient Artificial Memory
day.description: Pieces is a private, on-device, long-term memory layer for macOS, Linux, and Windows that proactively captures your work context as it happens. Over time, Pieces becomes your very own “internet of all context”—browse your artificial memories in the Pieces Desktop app, or plug them into the agents you already use: OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude, Cursor, Codex, etc.

day.name: Codex
day.description: A coding agent that helps you build and ship with AI

day.description: Mira is a Telegram-native AI assistant.
